# Ubepari PC workspace

- [x] Verify workspace instructions file exists.
- [x] Confirm project requirements: React, Vite, Express API, SQLite.
- [x] Scaffold the project in the workspace root.
- [x] Build the storefront and API-backed interactions.

Use `npm run dev` to run the Vite client and Express API together. The API uses SQLite through `sql.js`; database files are created under `data/` at runtime. Never represent demo savings goals, wallet balances, carrier choices, identity verification, or payment flows as live financial services.
